subject.title: fix(microsoft-foundry): handle stdout/stderr stream errors in az login

question: Should `shouldDetachChildForProcessTree`, `signalChildProcessTree`, and `forceKillChildProcessTree` become supported public plugin SDK functions for plugin-owned child lifecycles?
rationale: The bug fix needs an extension-safe process-tree seam, but publishing these low-level best-effort helpers creates a durable third-party API contract that automation cannot approve on maintainers' behalf.

options.title: Approve the narrow process-runtime API
options.body: Keep the three exports in the existing process-runtime subpath, document their platform and completion semantics, and treat them as supported plugin behavior.

options.title: Use a higher-level shutdown API
options.body: Replace the primitives with one purpose-built plugin-facing child-tree shutdown helper whose lifecycle and completion semantics are explicit.

options.title: Keep termination plugin-local
options.body: Avoid the SDK expansion and implement a Microsoft Foundry-owned wrapper, accepting duplicated platform behavior.

recommendation.title: Approve the narrow process-runtime API
recommendation.body: Keep the three exports in the existing process-runtime subpath, document their platform and completion semantics, and treat them as supported plugin behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: Their recent main work owns the authoritative process-tree implementation and current helper placement being promoted into the SDK.
